title: Tool and Adapter Integration
summary: This module provides mechanisms for integrating external tools and defining custom adapters to interface with Language Models (LMs). It includes utilities for wrapping functions as tools, handling tool calls, and defining various data types for multimodal interactions.

nodes.label: Create Tool Wrapper
nodes.title: Create Tool Wrapper
nodes.description: Generates Python code to wrap a function, allowing it to be called as a tool within the DSPy framework, handling argument serialization and deserialization.

nodes.label: Bridge Tool Calls
nodes.title: Bridge Tool Calls
nodes.description: Facilitates communication between the Python environment and the host environment for tool execution, handling JSON-RPC requests and responses for tool invocations.

nodes.label: Base Adapter
nodes.title: Base Adapter Class
nodes.description: Provides the foundational interface for transforming DSPy signatures and inputs into LM calls and parsing LM outputs back into structured data. It manages prompt formatting, conversation history, and native LM features like function calling.

nodes.label: BAML Adapter
nodes.title: BAML Adapter
nodes.description: An adapter that enhances the rendering of complex Pydantic models into a compact, human-readable schema for LMs, inspired by BAML's JSON formatter, improving token efficiency and LM comprehension.

nodes.label: Two-Step Adapter
nodes.title: Two-Step Adapter
nodes.description: Implements a two-stage process where a main LM generates a natural language response, and a smaller extraction model then parses structured data from that response, useful for reasoning models.

nodes.label: Base Type
nodes.title: Base Type Class
nodes.description: The foundational class for creating custom data types within DSPy signatures, enabling structured input/output for LMs and supporting multimodal interactions.

nodes.label: Audio Type
nodes.title: Audio Data Type
nodes.description: Represents audio data within DSPy, supporting various formats and encoding methods for multimodal LM interactions.

nodes.label: Citation Type
nodes.title: Citation Data Type
nodes.description: Manages citation information, allowing LMs to generate responses with references to provided documents or text segments.

nodes.label: Code Type
nodes.title: Code Data Type
nodes.description: Facilitates the handling of code snippets as input or output, useful for code generation, analysis, and execution tasks.

nodes.label: Document Type
nodes.title: Document Data Type
nodes.description: Encapsulates document content and metadata, enabling LMs to process and cite information from provided textual sources.

nodes.label: File Type
nodes.title: File Data Type
nodes.description: Represents file content, supporting various encoding and referencing methods for LMs to interact with external files.

nodes.label: Image Type
nodes.title: Image Data Type
nodes.description: Handles image data, including URLs and base64 encoded images, for multimodal LM interactions.

nodes.label: Tool Type
nodes.title: Tool Definition Type
nodes.description: Defines a callable tool with its name, description, and arguments, enabling LMs to invoke external functions or services.

groups.label: Tool Runners
groups.title: Tool Runners
groups.description: Components responsible for defining and executing external tools within the DSPy ecosystem.

groups.label: Adapters
groups.title: LM Adapters
groups.description: Classes that bridge DSPy signatures with Language Models, handling prompt formatting, response parsing, and native LM features.

groups.label: Data Types
groups.title: Custom Data Types
groups.description: Specialized data types for rich, multimodal interactions with Language Models, including audio, images, code, and structured documents.
